summary: Spring Valley Acquisition Corp. III filed an 8-K reporting an amended business combination agreement with General Fusion Inc. and NewCo. The original agreement, entered on January 21, 2026, was amended on May 12, 2026. The deal involves SVIII continuing from Cayman Islands to British Columbia, amalgamating with NewCo, and adopting new articles. No financial terms (price per share, premium, or valuation) were disclosed. The filing includes Rule 425 communications. The combination is structured as a SPAC merger expected to close post-shareholder vote. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearances; risk-arb centers on redemption levels and deal timing.
